descriptionMarkdown:
Purifier; You gain proficiency with flamers. Once per turn, fire damage you deal ignores resistance.

Purifier; Your flamer and firebomb damage increases by +1 per damage die against daemons, heretics, mutants, and corrupted creatures.

Purifier; Your fire damage ignores resistance, and daemons/corrupted creatures cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn after taking your fire damage.

Purifier; When you deal fire damage, one affected creature cannot benefit from cover against your next attack before your next turn.
